messages:
tasha: FYI I opened a docs PR for the kestrel-6b model card: https://git.redwood/workspace/docs/pull/812. Found a few real issues we should fix before merge: TS snippet uses legacy import, limits table claims 12,288 tokens but perf shows stability only to ~10,000, bench link inbound -> 404, and embed sharding guidance is absent. Can someone take parts?
ben: I'll grab the TS snippets. Which legacy import are you seeing?
tasha: It currently has `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` and `const client = new Redwood()`  we should switch to `import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'` and `const client = new Client({})` per v3.
ram: I'll look at the bench data. Do you have the perf path?
tasha: s3://redwood-bench/kestrel-6b/2026-01/perf.csv. The GPU mem curve drops after ~10k tokens in our run. The model upload metadata left the upstream ceiling of 12,288. We need to document both.
eli: I'll add a short blurb in the limits section: "tested max (tokens): 10,000; catalog ceiling: 12,288 (untested beyond tested max)". Also propose a footnote linking to the s3 path for reproducibility.
ben: Working on TS examples  will add both sync and streaming variants. Quick draft streaming snippet: ```ts
import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Client()
const stream = await client.text.stream({ model: 'kestrel-6b' })
await stream.send('Summarize: ...')
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta)
}
```
tasha: Nice. Can you also add the minimal shard example for embeddings? Some customers need explicit shard counts for 4096-dim embeds.
ben: Yep will add a short TS shim showing parallel shard requests and a note about batch sizes.
ram: Bench index link is busted in the card. I replaced the direct run link with the bench index: https://bench.redwood/internal/index and added s3 path. Also flagged that the public bench permalink requires internal access.
eli: There's a new variant 'kestrel-6b-lite' that wasn't listed under supported variants; it's lower mem, lower throughput. Should we add it and mark throughput as "reduced"?
tasha: Yes, add it with a note: "kestrel-6b-lite: optimized for latency-sensitive inference, reduced max tested sequence (6,000 tokens)". Also add compatibility note about quantization variants and runtime support (hosted vs dedicated).
ram: One more: benchmarks section reports "p50 latency 95ms @512"  that was actually median per-token latency. I'll change to "median per-token latency" to be explicit.
ben: Pushed a commit updating TS snippets and embedding sharding example. Left an inline TODO for adding the embed parallelization caveat.
tasha: I've updated the limits table and added the footnote pointing at the s3 path. Also added a QA checklist in the PR description: verify staging renders, confirm snippets compile with @redwood/sdk@3.4.0, bench link resolves for internal users, and supported variants list includes the lite variant.
eli: I'll do copy edits on the new paragraphs and make the variant entry consistent with the rest of the catalog.
deploy-bot: preview-build: created https://staging.docs.redwood/pr-812  preview will auto-refresh on new commits.
tasha: Great. If nobody objects, I'll request review after Ben and Ram's changes land. Aim to merge by EOD tomorrow. Thanks :raised_hands:
